test.create_query: CREATE TABLE promql_tags (id UInt64, metric_name LowCardinality(String), tags Map(LowCardinality(String), String), min_time DateTime64(3), max_time DateTime64(3)) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (metric_name, id)
CREATE TABLE promql_data (id UInt64, timestamp DateTime64(3), value Float64) ENGINE = MergeTree ORDER BY (id, timestamp)
CREATE TABLE promql_ts ENGINE = TimeSeries DATA promql_data TAGS promql_tags
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO promql_tags SELECT number + 1 AS id, 'm' AS metric_name, map('ns', 'ns' || toString(intDiv(number, 100)), 'pod', 'pod' || toString(number % 100)) AS tags, toDateTime64(0, 3) AS min_time, toDateTime64(21600, 3) AS max_time FROM numbers(5000)
INSERT INTO promql_data SELECT (number % 5000) + 1 AS id, toDateTime64(intDiv(number, 5000) * 15, 3) AS timestamp, (intDiv(number, 5000) * 15)::Float64 AS value FROM numbers_mt(5000 * 1440)
test.query: SELECT * FROM prometheusQueryRange('promql_ts', 'sum by (ns) (rate(m[5m]))', 3600, 21600, 60) FORMAT Null
SELECT * FROM prometheusQuery('promql_ts', 'sum by (ns) (rate(m[5m]))', 21600) FORMAT Null
